newsitem.title: UK: UK shares close lower for fifth day as Dow weakens.
newsitem.headline: UK shares close lower for fifth day as Dow weakens.

text.p: UK shares recovered some of their poise on Friday after sharp falls earlier in the week but still closed lower for a fifth day amid domestic political worries and fears of rising interest rates.

With the Dow down some 20 points, the FTSE ended 3.3 points lower at 4,254.8 -- its lowest since early February. Volume was active for a second day, reaching 923 million shares shortly after the close.
Shares took some comfort from Thursday's relatively steady performance in U.S. stocks and bonds following the latest scare over U.S. interest rates.
